entry: Studio settings > Brisk plan & billing > Change plan
priorityReason: Next executive-summary S2 UI blocker after the signed-off Media inspector and To Do editor; AC06 remains in the first implementation batch.

recommendations.title: Restore the visible Monthly / Annual choice
recommendations.current: At both1440 x1000 and1133 x1000, the frequency group is2px high while its buttons are40px high. A pointer click at Annual’s expected centre hits the Starter card; Monthly remains selected.
recommendations.proposal: Give the existing billing-frequency choice a stable, non-collapsing row above the cards. Keep both labels, clear selected state, native pressed semantics and visible keyboard focus. Retain its existing visual treatment rather than invent a new universal segmented component.
recommendations.confidence: High; fresh screenshots, geometry, hit testing and confirmation agree.
recommendations.tradeoff: The restored row uses a little more vertical space. Preserve readable text and full controls rather than compressing the plans to recover it.

recommendations.title: Keep the billing choice available while comparing
recommendations.current: Long cards already need body scrolling. At1133px, the plan-action buttons become fully visible after scrolling83px. Close stays visible and should remain so. This is a composition refinement, not a claim that those buttons are unreachable.
recommendations.proposal: Keep the title, frequency choice and Close visible; scroll the four-card comparison in one deliberate region. Preserve card order, both Monthly and Annual figures, current-plan identity, readable type and existing plan actions. Make this a local comparison layout change within the existing DS dialog.
recommendations.finding: Supports AC06; not a separate defect total
recommendations.confidence: High on observed scrolling; proposed arrangement needs Tom agreement.
recommendations.tradeoff: Pinning the choice leaves slightly less height for cards, but keeps billing context visible at the point of choosing. Alternative: let the full body scroll; simpler, but the choice disappears while comparing lower features.

recommendations.title: Keep the unconfirmed frequency when going Back
recommendations.current: Annual selected by keyboard reaches Business confirmation with the correct annual amount. Back reopens the comparison with Monthly selected. The comparison component remounts from the committed subscription frequency.
recommendations.proposal: Back returns to the same unconfirmed Monthly / Annual choice within the current comparison session. Close or Cancel ends that session; reopening starts from the current subscription as it does today. Keep the separate confirmation before any plan change.
recommendations.classification: Directly observed interaction; proposed draft-lifecycle refinement
recommendations.finding: PC02, new scoped observation related to the comparison flow
recommendations.confidence: High; reproduction and current state ownership agree.
recommendations.tradeoff: Retain only the temporary comparison choice, not a new preference or subscription change. Do not change pricing, commitment, entitlements or cancellation meaning.

browser.confirmations: Monthly and Annual Business confirmation inspected; no Confirm change submitted.
browser.back: Annual returns to Monthly; pending selection lost.
browser.scroll: At1133 plan actions reachable after83px body scroll; Close remains visible.
browser.finalState: Comparison closed; current Professional subscription still Monthly at$249 USD/month. Viewport reset and temporary tab closed.

approvedReference: No exact approved plan-comparison screenshot exists. DS EditingDialog/DialogSurface written guidance governs title/footer visibility, body scrolling, focus and modal behaviour. Current screenshots are evidence, not an approved new commercial design.
authority: Brisk DS/guidelines/components/quiet-choices.md: segmented inline controls are outside the generic quiet-choice migration
preserve: Four plans, their order and current-plan identity
Both monthly and annual price figures
Plan data, prices, limits, trials, sales actions and permissions
Existing DS modal styling, focus containment, Escape and Close
deferred: DEC08: V1 branding benefits versus current plan copy needs a separate product decision
Shortening/collapsing plan feature lists or changing four-card comparison into a new pricing page
New billing integrations or payment actions
verificationAfterApproval: 1440 and1133, full-height and shorter desktop; expanded/collapsed navigation
Visible pointer/Enter/Space Monthly and Annual controls; selected and focus states
All four plan cards and action rows reachable in a single intended scrolling region; header/frequency/Close stay visible
Monthly and Annual confirmation amounts, Back restores the draft frequency, Close/Cancel preserve current subscription
Current-plan versus chosen-frequency distinction; Enterprise sales action preserved without sending contact
Type check, affected route HTTP200, scoped diff and protected-file review
decision: Tom deferred plan comparison in chat: not important for the current pass; fix another time.
